Class KasaSmartPlug

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.kasa.KasaSmartPlug
public final class KasaSmartPlug extends Object
Allocation-free local control and discovery for legacy TP-Link Kasa HS100 and HS110 plugs.

Call openDiscovery() once after Wi-Fi connects, then broadcastDiscovery(byte[], int) and poll receiveDiscovery(byte[], int, int[]) for device endpoints. Pass a discovered endpoint to turnOn(int[], byte[], byte[], int) or turnOff(int[], byte[], byte[], int); it is an endpoint whose first four entries are the plug's IPv4 address. All buffers belong to the caller and can be allocated once before the program's main loop.

    • receiveDiscovery

      public static int receiveDiscovery(byte[] responseBuffer, int responseBufferLength, int[] endpoint)
      Decrypts the next discovery reply into responseBuffer and writes its sender to endpoint. Returns the JSON payload length, 0 while no reply waits, or -1 for invalid input or a malformed reply.

    • model

      public static int model(byte[] responseBuffer, int responseLength)
      Identifies an HS100 or HS110 from a decrypted discovery or system-information reply. Returns MODEL_UNKNOWN for every other Kasa/Tapo device or malformed input.
